calibration_protocol.status: additional exploratory descriptive visualization summary, separate from frozen statistical protocol
calibration_protocol.brier: Mean over images of SUM over 4 classes (probability minus one-hot target)^2; range 0 to 2; not divided by class count.
calibration_protocol.ece: Top-label expected calibration error: sum over 10 fixed equal-width confidence bins of (bin count / n) * abs(bin accuracy - bin mean maximum probability).
calibration_protocol.bins: [0,.1), [.1,.2), ..., [.9,1]; empty bins contribute zero; confidence 1 goes in final bin.
calibration_protocol.limits: No new intervals, significance tests or calibration fitting. ECE is bin/sample dependent and can mask classwise miscalibration. Neither metric establishes clinical reliability.

clinical_endpoint: Not plotted; AD/CN cohorts remain separate in frozen statistical analysis. No pooling with four-stage image outcomes.
